svg.title: Arrakis orbit 1984 — crimson twilight
svg.metadata:
arrakis-orbit-1984 texture credits
Planet maps by Solar System Scope / INOVE, based on NASA elevation and imagery. Source collection: https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/ Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0): https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
File: arrakis.jpg Source: https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/download/8k_mars.jpg Adapted: resized to 4096 x 2048, desaturated and recolored to sand and ochre. Copied from the existing arrakis-orbit assets. Recolored during rendering.
File: moon.jpg Source: https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/download/2k_moon.jpg Adapted: grayscale, resized to 1024 x 512 and JPEG recompressed. Copied from the existing arrakis-orbit assets. Recolored cyan during rendering.
These are artistic interpretations, not astronomical or canonical Dune maps. No endorsement by the texture authors or NASA is implied.
Actual shader exports at time zero. Cloud and star layers drift independently. Sphere rotation and procedural cloud evolution are baked.
